propositions: rebar claim hard-rejects plan-review op-certs signed by a different environment (foreign_key verdict) even when environment enforcement is not configured
verify_opcert_record unconditionally refuses any op-cert whose principal differs from the local environment's own_principal, before consulting trust roots or enforcement config
policy decision: certification environment must not gate acceptance when enforcement is unset; any cryptographically valid certificate is a certification regardless of signer environment

op-cert verification must distinguish between trust bases (own_key, pinned_environment, envelope_key) and accept self-consistent signatures even when the signer is unpinned, when enforcement is advisory
under optional enforcement (verify.require_environment + verify.opcert_enforce_since set), cross-environment certs must still be rejected and envelope-key fallback must be withheld
SSHSIG blobs carry their signer's public key embedded; unpinned signers' signatures can be fully verified via envelope key without a pinned trust root
